title: File:201406 Mountains in Ninghai National Fitness Trail.jpg
claims: A layered ridge view from a clearing on the Ninghai National Fitness Trail: dark forested slopes in the foreground, a broad wooded valley in the middle ground, and blue-grey hills under a pale sky; small cultivated plots sit at the lower left. It is a location photograph, not a 2026 race-day photograph, and it does not show a start arch, finish gantry, bib, timing mat, aid table, course marking or race crowd.

Commons titles the file 201406 Mountains in Ninghai National Fitness Trail.jpg. The route page uses it as Ninghai mountain-trail context for the UTNH-100 climb and night sections; it does not show the 2026 course line, a checkpoint, distance marker or race-day conditions.

The Commons author field reads MNXANL; the file is marked CC-BY-SA-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/); the relevant date is 2014-06-14 11:40:46; the file page gives a camera or subject position of 29.367382 N, 121.574768 E; the original is 2,560 × 1,920 px; 811,845 bytes.

The route page uses a 960 × 720 px; 195,870 bytes copy without cropping or colour change and credits MNXANL, CC-BY-SA-4.0 (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/), Wikimedia Commons; the resized copy keeps the same licence.
